eventDetail.eventTitle: 2027 5th Cognitive Models and Artificial Intelligence Conference (AICCONF)
eventDetail.about: Communication, Networking and Broadcast Technologies; Computing and Processing; Engineering Profession; Robotics and Control Systems; Signal Processing and Analysis
eventDetail.sponsors: IEEE Systems, Man, and Cybernetics Society; Tokat Gaziosmanpasa University
eventDetail.keywords: Artificial Intelligence, Cognitive Systems, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Brain Machine Interface, Intelligent Learning Systems,
eventDetail.scope: Cognitive Models and Artificial Intelligence Conference aims to share and discuss theoretical and practical knowledge in a scientific framework by bringing together scientists, experts, educators, non-governmental organizations, and private sector representatives. The main topics of the conference; Track 1 — Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Track 2 — Cognitive Computing and Computational Intelligence Track 3 — Natural Language Processing and Speech Technologies Track 4 — Computer Vision and Image Processing Track 5 — Robotics, Autonomous Systems and Intelligent Control Track 6 — Data Science, Big Data and Intelligent Analytics Track 7 — Internet of Things, Embedded Systems and Smart Technologies Track 8 — Cybersecurity, Privacy and Trustworthy Systems Track 9 — AI Applications in Engineering, Healthcare and Education Track 10 — Human-Centered AI, Ethics and Future Technologies
